name: aiwg
description: AIWG - Modular agentic framework for SDLC, marketing automation, and workflow orchestration. 200+ agents, 67+ CLI commands, 400+ deployable agent/skill/command/rule artifacts.

plugins.name: sdlc
plugins.description: Complete SDLC framework with 180+ specialized agents for software development lifecycle management.

plugins.name: marketing
plugins.description: Marketing automation framework with 37 specialized agents for campaign management.

plugins.name: voice
plugins.description: Voice profile system for consistent, authentic writing.

plugins.name: writing
plugins.description: Writing quality validation and AI pattern detection.

plugins.name: utils
plugins.description: Core AIWG utilities for context regeneration and workspace management.

plugins.name: forensics
plugins.description: Digital forensics and incident response framework with 14 specialized agents covering target profiling, evidence acquisition, log/memory/container/cloud analysis, IOC extraction, and reporting.

plugins.name: security-engineering
plugins.description: Applied security framework for cryptographic primitive selection, chain-of-trust design, authentication factor analysis, supply-chain trust, and physical-threat modeling. Complements OWASP-style application audits.

plugins.name: research
plugins.description: Research workflow framework with 9 specialized agents for discovery, acquisition, synthesis, citation management, GRADE quality assessment, and OAIS-compliant archival.

plugins.name: media-curator
plugins.description: Media archive management framework with 7 specialized agents for source discovery, acquisition (yt-dlp / Internet Archive / Bandcamp), quality assessment, metadata tagging, and provenance tracking.

plugins.name: ops
plugins.description: Operational infrastructure framework with 12 specialized agents covering incident response, runbook execution, fleet inventory, certificate lifecycle, and disaster recovery planning.

plugins.name: knowledge-base
plugins.description: Knowledge-base / wiki framework with skills for ingestion, query, and lint. Build a structured, citable corpus with cross-references and concept pages.

plugins.name: hooks
plugins.description: Claude Code hooks for workflow tracing and observability.

plugins.name: validation-complete
plugins.description: Validation Complete for AIWG

plugins.name: agent-loop
plugins.description: Iterative AI coding loops with automatic recovery - iteration beats perfection

plugins.name: agent-persistence
plugins.description: Human-in-the-loop (HITL) gate definitions for agent operations. Provides reusable YAML gates for destructive-action authorization, false-positive override, and recovery escalation. Loaded by agent loops and orchestrators that need bounded human checkpoints.

plugins.name: agentic-installer
plugins.description: Structured YAML manifests for reproducible, agent-driven software installation across platforms. Scripts are the primary artifact; agentic instructions handle adaptation and recovery.

plugins.name: aiwg-evals
plugins.description: Automated evaluation framework for agent quality, based on KAMI benchmark methodology and ReAct patterns

plugins.name: aiwg-dev
plugins.description: Developer tooling for building AIWG itself and AIWG addons/frameworks. Not for end users — install explicitly with `aiwg use aiwg-dev`.

plugins.name: auto-memory
plugins.description: Automatic memory seed templates for AIWG projects

plugins.name: browser-control
plugins.description: Drive a real, user-installed Chromium-derived browser from an AIWG agent. Wraps @playwright/mcp with a setup wizard, health-check doctor, allow-list enforcement, and an opinionated agent persona that respects authorization and audit boundaries.

plugins.name: color-palette
plugins.description: Color palette selection and review tooling with color theory fundamentals, current trend research, and accessibility analysis.

plugins.name: context-curator
plugins.description: Context curation and distractor filtering for production-grade agent reliability

plugins.name: compound-memory
plugins.description: Governed orchestration across AIWG line memory, semantic memory, and llm-wiki.

plugins.name: daemon
plugins.description: Persistent daemon session capabilities: Concierge front-end, session memory, scheduler integration

plugins.name: doc-intelligence
plugins.description: Documentation intelligence addon for scraping, extraction, analysis, and generated-docs auditing.

plugins.name: droid-bridge
plugins.description: MCP server bridging Claude Code to Factory Droid for batch operations and automated fixes

plugins.name: guided-implementation
plugins.description: Bounded iteration control for autonomous issue-to-code implementation

plugins.name: line-memory
plugins.description: Bounded, plain-text project memory with least-recently-used retention.

plugins.name: llm-wiki
plugins.description: LLM-maintained markdown wiki that compounds as sources are ingested. Thin topology declaration on the semantic memory kernel — ships schema profiles and page templates, no custom mechanics.

plugins.name: nlp-prod
plugins.description: Tools, skills, and CLI extensions for designing and productionizing LLM inference pipelines. Pattern-guided, slim by default, eval-first.

plugins.name: prose-integration
plugins.description: Tools for reading, parsing, validating, and executing OpenProse programs from AIWG workflows

plugins.name: rlm
plugins.description: RLM-inspired recursive context decomposition for processing arbitrarily large codebases and document corpora through programmatic sub-agent delegation

plugins.name: semantic-memory
plugins.description: Topology-agnostic semantic memory operations: ingest, lint, query-capture, and structured event logging. Consumers declare a memory topology in their manifest.json; kernel skills read that contract to parameterize behavior.

plugins.name: skill-factory
plugins.description: Build, enhance, validate, and package Claude skills end-to-end. Coordinates skill-builder, skill-enhancer, quality-checker, and skill-packager via the skill-architect agent.

plugins.name: star-prompt
plugins.description: Tasteful prompt to encourage users to star the repository after successful command completion

plugins.name: testing-quality
plugins.description: Evidence-bound test conformance, platform protocols, normalization transactions and research-guided testing workflows

plugins.name: twelve-factor
plugins.description: Design-time and audit-time workflows for Twelve-Factor and modern 12+ Factor cloud-native application practices.

plugins.name: uat-mcp
plugins.description: Agent-executable acceptance testing via MCP connections — generate, execute, and report on UAT plans that validate MCP tool surfaces.

plugins.name: verbalized-sampling
plugins.description: Training-free prompting technique that improves output diversity by 1.6-2.1x through verbalized probability distributions, addressing RLHF mode collapse

plugins.name: training
plugins.description: Corpus-to-dataset pipeline for AI training data curation. Ingests sources, synthesizes examples, generates DPO/KTO preference pairs, applies decontamination, and exports to Alpaca/ShareGPT/ChatML/JSONL/Parquet with provenance. Optional Python runtime (aiwg-training CLI) for scale.
